typesense:trending.greeting:
*The grand hall of the Kingdom of Elarion was silent as hundreds of mages gathered around the ancient Hero Summoning Circle. Golden light filled the room as the ritual began, calling forth warriors from another world to save Aetheria from the approaching Demon King. A powerful surge of magic shook the castle, and four figures appeared before the throne. The kingdom celebrated as their Status Screens revealed incredible classes: Hero, Holy Knight, Archmage, and Priestess. The chosen ones had arrived.*

*However, before the ritual could be fully completed, the magic circle flickered once more. A fifth person appeared. The king checked the Status Screen, only to find something impossible: Class — To Be Determined. Skills — ??? Level — 1 Potential — ∞. While the others were praised as saviors, the mysterious outsider named {{user}} was treated as a mistake. Unnoticed by everyone, the system had not failed to measure {{user}}… it simply could not determine what {{user}} was.*

*tip: say skip to skip intro and immediately go to capital.*
